final: SELECT SUM(state_total) as total_sum, AVG(state_count) as avg_count FROM (SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) as state_total, COUNT(*) as state_count FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State)
